metadata.model: Indonesia Energy Crisis Model v3.0 — Real Public Data

scenarios.name: coal_supply_disruption
scenarios.description: Major coal supply disruption due to export ban reversal, mining accidents, or logistics failure. Coal is 67-68% of electricity (ESDM 2024-2025, IEEFA 2026). Coal production 833 Mt in 2024 (EIA), exports 615 Mt.
scenarios.trigger: Coal mine flooding / export policy shift / rail logistics collapse

scenarios.name: extreme_heat_wave
scenarios.description: Prolonged El Niño driven heatwave pushes temperatures above 38°C across Java. AC demand surges while hydro output drops due to drought. Java-Bali system already has ~6 GW overcapacity but contractual PPA constraints limit flexibility (IEA).
scenarios.trigger: El Niño event / climate change amplification

scenarios.name: grid_cascade_failure
scenarios.description: Cascading grid failure triggered by transmission line fault on the Java-Bali interconnected system. Java-Bali carries 61 GW capacity serving 60% of national demand. Coal IPP capacity = 2/3 of Java-Bali peak demand (IEA), creating inflexible baseload.
scenarios.trigger: Transmission line failure / transformer overload / cyberattack

scenarios.name: natural_gas_price_shock
scenarios.description: Global LNG price spike (3x) makes gas-fired generation uneconomic. Gas is 17.7% of generation mix (ESDM 2024). Gas plants reduce output; coal plants (48% utilization in 2023) cannot ramp fast enough.

scenarios.name: crude_oil_price_shock
scenarios.description: Global crude oil price spike (2x) due to Middle East conflict or OPEC+ cuts. Indonesia imports ~1.1M bbl/day (production only ~608K bbl/day). 2026 budget assumes ICP $70/bbl — every $1 increase = Rp 7T fiscal impact (ESI). Fuel reserve only 21-23 days (Energy Council). Inflation already 4.76% (Feb 2026).
scenarios.trigger: Middle East conflict / OPEC+ production cuts / sanctions disruption

scenarios.name: renewable_transition_gap
scenarios.description: Coal plant retirements outpace renewable + storage buildout. RUPTL 2025-2034 targets 42.6 GW NRE + 10.3 GW storage. NRE target missed 9 consecutive years (IESR 2026). 2025 NRE realization only 14.4% vs 15.9% RUPTL target. 23% target pushed from 2025 to 2030.
scenarios.trigger: Policy-driven coal retirement without adequate replacement
